invariants.rationale: The method unconditionally throws an exception and never returns a value, so 'result' must always be null at the exit.
The method throws immediately, so its parameters are unchanged and should reflect typical method preconditions, such as not being null.
Likewise, safety in method logic would suggest this parameter is non-null on entry and, since the body does not change it, on exit too.
Method parameters are unchanged due to the method always throwing an exception.
Storage configuration is expected to be provided; since the method throws immediately, it remains in its initial state.
